title: Finland Walks a Fiscal Tightrope as Austerity Bites and Recovery Remains… · 24 Aug
keywords: Finland, austerity, fiscal policy, budget cuts, economic stabilisation, unemployment, inflation, coalition government, European Union, public finances, household economy, NATO defence spending
notes: Finland's coalition government is pressing ahead with a multi-year package of tax cuts and spending restraint, even as its finance minister signals that further savings may be required this autumn. The strategy has deepened a central political divide over whether fiscal discipline is repairing the country's public finances or suppressing a recovery that has yet to take hold. With unemployment above the euro-area average and household confidence still shaky, the stakes extend well beyond Helsinki.
